comment: Named arenas (W05, superseding K05). Each encounter references one by arenaId. nest-boss-room's geometry is measured in docs/killer-bee-queen-geometry-source.md: flatHalfWidthTiles 9.5 is the measured walkable half-span (W03), and cornerSumTiles 14.25 is the measured chamfer constant, 1.5 * 9.5 (W03). The honey hazards are the source's zones A/D (W07): a 3.5-tile half-diagonal diamond at the pond and an annulus from 7.5 to 9.5 tiles at the outer ring, both counted by the user rather than directly measured.
